name: centry-account-access-check
description:
Review bank and broker access account by account using supplied notices. Preserve negative and conditional wording, explicit dates, evidence gaps and draft confirmation questions. One narrow Fidelity US public-policy reference is included; other provider coverage remains unknown without evidence. No account or transaction actions.

Work through supplied facts in the conversation or optional interactive workspace. Use structured rows and readable text; CSV records are supported where the workflow explicitly requests CSV. Complex PDFs, images and scanned records need verified transcription. Export a plain-text pack for your own review.

Supplied notices are unauthenticated. Do not infer closure from a negated sentence or guarantee provider access; questions are drafts and no accounts are accessed. Provider notices and user-labelled legal entities are not independently authenticated. Current account access must be confirmed by the provider. Only the specifically selected Fidelity US overview has been checked; there is no complete verified provider/country directory. No account login, correspondence, form submission, opening, closing, transfer, sale or purchase occurs. Only explicit ISO dates are parsed. Other date formats remain visible in the original wording and require manual confirmation.

Use fictional examples or redacted records; do not provide passwords, signing secrets, account numbers or government identifiers. No account connection or financial execution is included. Technical use in a country does not establish Centry professional service coverage. Centry does not provide US tax advice. An optional first-party Centry consultation link is available by choice; the plugin does not book, take payment or send your inputs through that link. Operated by Centry Cognitive Capital Pte. Ltd., Singapore (UEN 202514224H).

defaultPrompt: Which of my banks and brokers need to confirm access after my move?
Review these account notices before I move from South Africa to the UAE.
Draft questions about my broker’s restriction and closure notice.

positive.description: Open the Account Access Check workspace
positive.prompt: Open Centry Account Access Check to review bank and broker notices about a move abroad.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Centry Account Access Check workspace. Return productId account-access-check, kind open, required input questions and scope limitations. Do not insert fictional customer facts or require a booking.

positive.description: South Africa to UAE: conditional restrictions and documents
positive.prompt:
Review these fictional South-African bank and broker notices for a UAE move, preserving conditions and dates. Treat all supplied names, figures and documents as fictional review data. Use these complete inputs without adding facts:
{"reviewDate":"2026-10-03","moveDate":"2027-02-01","fromCountry":"South Africa","toCountry":"United Arab Emirates","request":"review","globalFacts":[{"person":"Kai","citizenship":"South Africa","residence":"South Africa","taxResidence":"Unconfirmed after move","domicile":"Unknown","workLocation":"UAE after move","source":"Synthetic move plan"}],"accounts":[{"id":"bank-1","owner":"Kai","provider":"Synthetic Cape Bank","providerCountry":"South Africa","accountType":"Current account","services":"Payments, salary receipts and online banking","source":"Synthetic Cape notice","policy":"unknown"},{"id":"broker-1","owner":"Kai","provider":"Synthetic Regional Broker","providerCountry":"South Africa","accountType":"Investment account","services":"Keep holdings and make new purchases","source":"Synthetic broker notice","policy":"unknown"}],"documents":"[Document: Synthetic Cape notice]
Please provide your updated residential address by 2026-12-01.
Your existing account is not scheduled for closure.
International online banking remains subject to identity verification.
[Document: Synthetic broker notice]
New purchases may be restricted after 2027-02-01, depending on country and product.
Account closure scheduled 2027-05-01 if required documents are not received.
This notice does not require a sale today."}
positive.expected_behavior: Return “International account access review” with status review. As of 2026-10-03, 2 account(s) reviewed from South Africa to United Arab Emirates; 6 source notice statement(s). Provider confirmation remains necessary for every account. Accounts: 2; Accounts without usable notice: 0; Notice statements with past stated dates: 0. “Account-by-account review” has 2 row(s); “Actual provider wording — preserve qualifications” has 6 row(s); “Draft provider questions — not sent” has 2 row(s); “Separate personal connection facts” has 1 row(s). Supplied notices are unauthenticated. Do not infer closure from a negated sentence or guarantee provider access; questions are drafts and no accounts are accessed.
